evidence: Touches src/txmempool.cpp and src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.cpp with the 'TX fees and policy' area label.
rationale: Fixes false confirmation reporting in fee estimators and missing conflict events when blocks confirm a different witness variant of a mempool transaction. As noted in the description, matching solely by txid caused 'fee estimators to record false confirmations, distorting coverage statistics with local witness weights' and suppressed conflict notifications.
